# Kids Birthday Card

[Photo](../README.md) › [Print & Stationery](../README.md#print--stationery) · `print` `greeting-card` `warp-text` `shapes` `layer-styles` `groups` `illustration`

A cheerful seventh-birthday card front with arched headline type, balloons, a big number badge and scattered confetti.

## About

The front of a folded 5 × 7 card. "HAPPY BIRTHDAY" is live type bent with Warp Text (Arc), with
a white Stroke and a soft Drop Shadow. The confetti is five shape layers, one per colour, each
combining dots, stars and rotated strips; the balloons are groups of an ellipse, a knot, a
highlight and a bezier string; the badge number has a Bevel & Emboss.
